messages:
marie (docs): Hey team — opened a PR to clarify embedding sharding behavior in the model cards and refresh the SDK quickstart snippet. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
marie (docs): Main things in the PR: 1) explicit note about how we round up shard counts for small inputs, 2) compatibility caveat with quantized CPU fallbacks, 3) updated SDK snippet that shows embed sharding + deterministic ordering.
devon (ml): Thanks — can you paste the proposed SDK snippet here so I can run the internal eval?
marie (docs): Sure — current snippet we have is short, this is the proposed one:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
texts = ["doc1", "doc2", "doc3"]
# shard_size controls how we split for large corpuses
embs = client.embeddings.create(model="nebula-embed-1", inputs=texts, shard_size=2)
# embs is a flat list aligned to inputs (deterministic order)
```

marie (docs): I added a small note highlighting that when shard_size > len(inputs) we still allocate one shard (round up) and that some edge-cases with streaming-derived post-processing can reorder if you rely on async callbacks.
sachin (runtime): Quick question: does the note explain behavior when runtime falls back to CPU-quantized variant? We saw a tiny difference in float32 vs quantized ordering when using batch-level padding. We should call out that ordering is deterministic but numeric differences can affect dedup heuristics.
marie (docs): Good call — I added one sentence 'CPU-quantized fallbacks may introduce minor numeric drift; use the model variant pinning option in Dedicated/Private for strict reproducibility.'
eden (sdk): Eden here — snippet looks fine, but SDK idiom is slightly different in v3: we prefer an explicit ShardConfig object. Suggest changing example to:

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient, ShardConfig
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
shard_cfg = ShardConfig(size=2, deterministic=True)
embs = client.embeddings.create(model="nebula-embed-1", inputs=texts, shard_config=shard_cfg)
```

eden (sdk): Also propose adding a one-liner showing how to verify ordering after call: `assert len(embs) == len(texts)` and `# map back by index, not by content`
cleO (pm): typo: probably cleo (pm) — small product note: customers often confuse 'shard_size' with 'max_shard_bytes' — can we add a short table or link in the model card to the policy that converts tokens -> shards?
marie (docs): Yep, added a short link to the sharding policy doc and a tiny table with the formula: shards = ceil(total_tokens / shard_size_tokens). Kept it one line.
devon (ml): I'll run the eval on the PR branch. If embedding similarity AUC drops >0.005 vs main when using quant fallback, we should include a recommended mitigation (pin variant or re-embed). I'll post results by EOD.
sachin (runtime): On the runtime side, can you add a one-sentence note about fallback capacity tiers? e.g., 'When capacity triggers model variant fallback, requests may be routed to quantized variants in the same family — check per-route logs in Console.' That helps support and SRE triage.
marie (docs): Added that. Also added a tiny troubleshooting block with a sample log query: `service:inference AND model:nebula-embed-1 AND response_variant:quantized`
devon (ml): FYI I ran the A/B against 5000 pairs — numeric drift within 0.002 AUC, safe to ship. Will paste benchmark table soon. :ok_hand:
eden (sdk): One more thing — we should update the quickstart link reference in the SDK README to point to the new snippet path. I can follow up with the small PR there after this merges.
marie (docs): Thanks — I've left a TODO in the PR. Also fixed 3 internal links that previously pointed to the old shard design doc (link fixes).
doc-bot: automatic check: spellcheck passed, linkcheck flagged one dangling anchor in model-cards/nebula.md#old-shard-params — suggested replacement: model-cards/sharding.md#params
marie (docs): Fixed the anchor and pushed.
cleo (pm): Great progress. Quick rollout plan: ship docs change + SDK README pointer within 48h, then create a customer note for Dedicated tenants about variant pinning. I'll own the note.
marie (docs): Wonderful. Final ask: @sachin @eden can you give LGTM on the PR if the small wording tweaks land? I want to merge before tomorrow's docs cut.
sachin (runtime): LGTM after wording tweak applied.
eden (sdk): LGTM, will follow up on the SDK README PR.
marie (docs): Thanks everyone — merging after CI finishes. :rocket:
